# Mystic Jade Theme for Phlix

A near-black cool-green UI theme for Phlix with bright teal accents.

## Overview

Mystic Jade extends the built-in `midnight` base with near-black cool-green
grounds (`#030a08` up through the elevation stack) and a bright teal accent
ramp led by `#2dd4bf`. The name is mood, not hue: where Jade's own accent is
jade-green (`#50c878`), Mystic Jade runs teal on darker grounds, with the
same quiet grain (both `0.035`) and a vignette and ambient glow re-tuned to
the teal hue.

## Installation

Install and enable are **two separate actions**: installing only stages the
plugin's code on disk — the theme appears in the picker only after it is
enabled.

**Admin UI** — *Admin → Plugins* (`/app/admin/plugins`), find **Mystic Jade**,
press **Install**, then flip its switch to enable it. The page posts this
repository's URL to `POST /api/v1/admin/plugins/install` and the server
supplies the catalog pin (exact `ref` + `artifactSha256`) itself; without a
catalog entry the install is refused outright — deliberate default-deny, with
the operator escape hatch `PHLIX_PLUGINS_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED=1` (phlix-server
`PluginLoader::ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_ENV`).

**CLI** — the same thing, from the server root. Pass the **repository URL**,
not the plugin name: the installer downloads from that string verbatim, and a
bare name is not downloadable.

```bash
php bin/phlix plugin:install https://github.com/detain/phlix-plugin-mystic-jade-theme
php bin/phlix plugin:enable  phlix-plugin-mystic-jade-theme
php bin/phlix plugin:list
```

`composer require` into the host checkout is not the supported install path —
the plugin loader manages its own per-plugin vendor directory.

## Color Palette

### Core Colors

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--bg` | `#030a08` | Page background |
| `--surface` | `#071210` | Card/panel backgrounds |
| `--surface-2` | `#0e1f18` | Elevated surfaces |
| `--surface-3` | `#152b22` | Highest elevation |
| `--surface-glass` | `rgba(7, 18, 16, 0.65)` | Translucent frosted surfaces (overlays) |
| `--surface-glass-strong` | `rgba(3, 10, 8, 0.85)` | Opaque-tier glass (docks, auth card, player panels) |
| `--accent` | `#2dd4bf` | Primary accent (teal-400) |

### Accent Variants

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--accent-hover` | `#5eead4` | Hover state accent |
| `--accent-active` | `#14b8a6` | Active/pressed state |
| `--accent-soft` | `rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.12)` | Soft accent-tinted fills |
| `--accent-ring` | `rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.6)` | Focus ring color |
| `--accent-text` | `#5eead4` | Accent-tinted foreground text on the dark surfaces |

### Text Colors

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--text` | `#e8f5f0` | Primary text |
| `--text-muted` | `#9cb8ac` | Secondary text |
| `--text-subtle` | `#779889` | Tertiary text |
| `--text-faint` | `#668277` | Disabled/hint text (placeholder ink — AA-pinned, see `tests/TokenContrastTest.php`) |
| `--text-on-accent` | `#02100d` | Dark ink drawn on solid `--accent` fills (buttons, badges) |

### Border Colors

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--border` | `#1a3028` | Default borders |
| `--border-subtle` | `#101e19` | Subtle borders |
| `--border-strong` | `#2a4a3c` | Emphasized borders |

### Atmosphere

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `--ambient` | `rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.15)` | Ambient glow |
| `--vignette` | `rgba(0, 8, 5, 0.5)` | Edge darkening |
| `--grain-opacity` | `0.035` | Film grain effect |

### Legacy `--color-*` Aliases

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--color-bg` | `#030a08` | Legacy alias — mirrors `--bg` |
| `--color-surface` | `#071210` | Legacy alias — mirrors `--surface` |
| `--color-text` | `#e8f5f0` | Legacy alias — mirrors `--text` |
| `--color-text-muted` | `#9cb8ac` | Legacy alias — mirrors `--text-muted` |
| `--color-border` | `#1a3028` | Legacy alias — mirrors `--border` |

`phlix-tokens/src/css/colors.css` declares every `--color-*` name as a
`var(--modern-token)` indirection inside each theme block, so these explicit
values are belt-and-braces for un-migrated `var(--color-*)` readers rather
than a second cascade layer.

## Theme Tokens

The payload is the single source of truth in
[`MysticJadePlugin::providedThemes()`](src/MysticJadePlugin.php) — a theme
envelope (`id` / `name` / `dark` / `extends`) plus 28 CSS custom properties,
names keeping their `--` prefix on the wire. All 28 tokens and their exact
values are tabled above; a trimmed sketch of the real shape:

```json
{
  "id": "mystic-jade",
  "name": "Mystic Jade",
  "dark": true,
  "extends": "midnight",
  "tokens": {
    "--accent": "#2dd4bf",
    "--accent-text": "#5eead4",
    "--bg": "#030a08",
    "--text-on-accent": "#02100d"
  }
}
```

The `--accent-*` ramp carries one teal hue. `--accent-text` is an
accent-tinted foreground for text sitting on the dark surfaces — the text
color for chips filled with solid `--accent` is `--text-on-accent`.

## Requirements

- PHP >= 8.3
- Phlix >= 0.44.0

## Development

Install dependencies:

```bash
composer install
```

Run the test suite (`phpunit.xml`, bootstrapped by `tests/bootstrap.php`):

```bash
composer test
```

Run static analysis (`phpstan.neon`, level 9) and coding standards (`phpcs.xml`, PSR-12):

```bash
composer phpstan
composer phpcs
```

Both static gates cover `scripts/security-audit-check.php` as well as the
PHP source: the S440 gate script is analyzed at level 9 with zero ignores
and checked under PSR-12 (two sniffs are scoped off for `scripts/` only —
the reasons are pinned in `phpcs.xml`; the script itself is a byte-frozen
family template).

`tests/bootstrap.php` loads `dev-stubs/LifecycleInterface.php` and `dev-stubs/ThemeSourceInterface.php` only when the real host contracts are absent, so the suite runs outside a Phlix server checkout. `.github/workflows/test.yml` runs the same three checks on PHP 8.3 and 8.4, plus the S440 dependency-audit leg (`composer-audit` job — `php scripts/security-audit-check.php`, locked down by `tests/SecurityAuditCheckTest.php`).

namespace Phlix\MysticJade;

use Phlix\Shared\Plugin\LifecycleInterface;

final class MysticJadePlugin implements LifecycleInterface, ThemeSourceInterface
{
    public const SOURCE_NAME = 'mystic-jade';

    public function onEnable(ContainerInterface $container): void
    {
    }

    public function onDisable(): void
    {
    }

        return [];
    }

    public function themeSourceName(): string
    {
        return self::SOURCE_NAME;

    public function providedThemes(): array

        return [

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Phlix\Shared\Plugin;

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Phlix\MysticJade\Tests;

use Phlix\MysticJade\MysticJadePlugin;
use Phlix\Shared\Plugin\LifecycleInterface;
use Phlix\Theming\ThemeSourceInterface;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class MysticJadePluginTest extends TestCase
{
    private MysticJadePlugin $plugin;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->plugin = new MysticJadePlugin();
    }

    public function testImplementsLifecycleInterface(): void
    {
        $this->assertInstanceOf(LifecycleInterface::class, $this->plugin);
    }

    public function testImplementsThemeSourceInterface(): void
    {
        $this->assertInstanceOf(ThemeSourceInterface::class, $this->plugin);
    }

    public function testThemeSourceNameReturnsCorrectValue(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('mystic-jade', $this->plugin->themeSourceName());
    }

    public function testProvidedThemesReturnsExpectedStructure(): void
    {
        $themes = $this->plugin->providedThemes();

        $this->assertCount(1, $themes);

        $theme = $themes[0];
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('id', $theme);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('name', $theme);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('dark', $theme);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('extends', $theme);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('tokens', $theme);

        $this->assertSame('mystic-jade', $theme['id']);
        $this->assertSame('Mystic Jade', $theme['name']);
        $this->assertTrue($theme['dark']);
        $this->assertSame('midnight', $theme['extends']);
    }

    public function testAllTokensAreValidCssValues(): void
    {
        $themes = $this->plugin->providedThemes();
        $tokens = $themes[0]['tokens'];

        $this->assertIsArray($tokens);

        foreach ($tokens as $tokenName => $tokenValue) {
            $this->assertIsString($tokenName, "Token name must be string");
            $this->assertIsString($tokenValue, "Token value must be string");

            $this->assertStringStartsWith('--', $tokenName, "Token name must start with '--'");

            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('var(', $tokenValue, "Token value must not contain var() references");
        }
    }

    public function testOnEnableDoesNotThrow(): void
    {
        $container = $this->createMock(\Psr\Container\ContainerInterface::class);

        $this->plugin->onEnable($container);

        $this->assertCount(1, $this->plugin->providedThemes());
    }

    public function testOnDisableDoesNotThrow(): void
    {
        $this->plugin->onDisable();

        $this->assertSame('mystic-jade', $this->plugin->themeSourceName());
    }

    public function testSubscribedEventsReturnsEmptyArray(): void
    {
        $events = $this->plugin->subscribedEvents();
        $this->assertEmpty($events);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Phlix\MysticJade\Tests;

use Phlix\MysticJade\MysticJadePlugin;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use RuntimeException;

#[CoversClass(MysticJadePlugin::class)]
final class TokenContrastTest extends TestCase
{
    private const AA_TEXT_RATIO = 4.5;

    private const NON_TEXT_RATIO = 3.0;

    private const INPUT_SURFACE_ALPHA = 0.8;

    private MysticJadePlugin $plugin;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->plugin = new MysticJadePlugin();
    }

    private function tokens(): array
    {
        $themes = $this->plugin->providedThemes();
        $tokens = $themes[0]['tokens'];

        return $tokens;
    }

    private function grounds(): array
    {
        $tokens = $this->tokens();
        $grounds = [];
        foreach (['--bg', '--surface', '--surface-2', '--surface-3'] as $key) {
            $grounds[$key] = $tokens[$key];
        }

        return $grounds;
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testAccentTextMeetsAaAsForegroundOnEveryGround(): void
    {
        $ink = $this->tokens()['--accent-text'];

        foreach ($this->grounds() as $name => $ground) {
            $ratio = $this->contrastRatio($ink, $ground);
            $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(
                self::AA_TEXT_RATIO,
                $ratio,
                sprintf(
                    '--accent-text %s on %s (%s) is %.2f:1 — below the 4.5:1 AA foreground floor',
                    $ink,
                    $name,
                    $ground,
                    $ratio
                )
            );
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testTextOnAccentMeetsAaAsInkOnTheAccentFill(): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->tokens();
        $ratio = $this->contrastRatio($tokens['--text-on-accent'], $tokens['--accent']);

        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(
            self::AA_TEXT_RATIO,
            $ratio,
            sprintf(
                '--text-on-accent %s on --accent %s is %.2f:1 — below the 4.5:1 AA floor',
                $tokens['--text-on-accent'],
                $tokens['--accent'],
                $ratio
            )
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testTextSubtleMeetsAaAsBodyTierOnEveryGround(): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->tokens();
        $ink = $tokens['--text-subtle'];
        $graded = $this->grounds();
        $graded['input composite'] = $this->composite(
            $tokens['--surface'],
            self::INPUT_SURFACE_ALPHA,
            $tokens['--bg']
        );

        foreach ($graded as $name => $ground) {
            $ratio = $this->contrastRatio($ink, $ground);
            $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(
                self::AA_TEXT_RATIO,
                $ratio,
                sprintf(
                    '--text-subtle %s on %s (%s) is %.2f:1 — below the 4.5:1 AA floor',
                    $ink,
                    $name,
                    $ground,
                    $ratio
                )
            );
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testTextFaintMeetsAaAsPlaceholderInkOnTheAuthGrounds(): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->tokens();
        $ink = $tokens['--text-faint'];
        $graded = [
            '--bg' => $tokens['--bg'],
            '--surface' => $tokens['--surface'],
            'input composite' => $this->composite(
                $tokens['--surface'],
                self::INPUT_SURFACE_ALPHA,
                $tokens['--bg']
            ),
        ];

        foreach ($graded as $name => $ground) {
            $ratio = $this->contrastRatio($ink, $ground);
            $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(
                self::AA_TEXT_RATIO,
                $ratio,
                sprintf(
                    '--text-faint %s on %s (%s) is %.2f:1 — below the 4.5:1 AA floor',
                    $ink,
                    $name,
                    $ground,
                    $ratio
                )
            );
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testAccentRingMeetsNonTextMinimumUnderEveryAdjacency(): void
    {
        $ring = $this->parseRgba($this->tokens()['--accent-ring']);

        $grounds = [];
        foreach ($this->grounds() as $name => $hex) {
            $grounds[$name] = $this->parseHex($hex);
        }

        foreach ($grounds as $onName => $paintedOn) {
            $painted = $this->compositeOver($ring, $paintedOn);
            foreach ($grounds as $adjName => $adjacent) {
                $ratio = $this->contrastRatioRgb($painted, $adjacent);
                $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(
                    self::NON_TEXT_RATIO,
                    $ratio,
                    sprintf(
                        '--accent-ring painted on %s is %s vs adjacent %s: '
                        . '%.2f:1 — below the 3:1 non-text minimum',
                        $onName,
                        $this->toHex($painted),
                        $adjName,
                        $ratio
                    )
                );
            }
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testRampKeepsFaintBelowSubtleBelowMutedInLuminance(): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->tokens();
        $faint = $this->relativeLuminance($this->parseHex($tokens['--text-faint']));
        $subtle = $this->relativeLuminance($this->parseHex($tokens['--text-subtle']));
        $muted = $this->relativeLuminance($this->parseHex($tokens['--text-muted']));

        $this->assertLessThan(
            $subtle,
            $faint,
            '--text-faint must stay strictly darker than --text-subtle (ramp order)'
        );
        $this->assertLessThan(
            $muted,
            $subtle,
            '--text-subtle must stay strictly darker than --text-muted (ramp order)'
        );
    }

    private function composite(string $topHex, float $alpha, string $bottomHex): string
    {
        $top = $this->parseHex($topHex);
        $bottom = $this->parseHex($bottomHex);
        $mixed = [];
        foreach ($top as $index => $channel) {
            $mixed[$index] = (int) round($alpha * $channel + (1 - $alpha) * $bottom[$index]);
        }

        return sprintf('#%02x%02x%02x', $mixed[0], $mixed[1], $mixed[2]);
    }

    private function relativeLuminance(array $rgb): float
    {
        $channels = [];
        foreach ($rgb as $channel) {
            $srgb = $channel / 255;
            $channels[] = $srgb <= 0.04045
                ? $srgb / 12.92
                : ((($srgb + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4);
        }

        return 0.2126 * $channels[0] + 0.7152 * $channels[1] + 0.0722 * $channels[2];
    }

    private function contrastRatio(string $hexA, string $hexB): float
    {
        return $this->contrastRatioRgb($this->parseHex($hexA), $this->parseHex($hexB));
    }

    private function contrastRatioRgb(array $rgbA, array $rgbB): float
    {
        $luminanceA = $this->relativeLuminance($rgbA);
        $luminanceB = $this->relativeLuminance($rgbB);
        $brighter = max($luminanceA, $luminanceB);
        $darker = min($luminanceA, $luminanceB);

        return ($brighter + 0.05) / ($darker + 0.05);
    }

    private function parseHex(string $hex): array
    {
        $matches = [];
        if (preg_match('/^#([0-9a-fA-F]{2})([0-9a-fA-F]{2})([0-9a-fA-F]{2})$/', $hex, $matches) !== 1) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Contrast law expects literal #rrggbb, got '$hex'");
        }

        return [
            (int) hexdec($matches[1]),
            (int) hexdec($matches[2]),
            (int) hexdec($matches[3]),
        ];
    }

    private function compositeOver(array $rgba, array $ground): array
    {
        [$r, $g, $b, $alpha] = $rgba;

        return [
            (int) round($alpha * $r + (1 - $alpha) * $ground[0]),
            (int) round($alpha * $g + (1 - $alpha) * $ground[1]),
            (int) round($alpha * $b + (1 - $alpha) * $ground[2]),
        ];
    }

    private function parseRgba(string $value): array
    {
        $matches = [];
        if (
            preg_match('/^rgba\((\d{1,3}), (\d{1,3}), (\d{1,3}), (0?\.\d+|1|0)\)$/', $value, $matches)
                !== 1
        ) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Contrast law expects literal rgba(r, g, b, a), got '$value'");
        }

        return [
            (int) $matches[1],
            (int) $matches[2],
            (int) $matches[3],
            (float) $matches[4],
        ];
    }

    private function toHex(array $rgb): string
    {
        return sprintf('#%02x%02x%02x', $rgb[0], $rgb[1], $rgb[2]);
    }
